established_contract: supported loading expects an environment with the same package versions as the training environment
loading a model trained or persisted with a different scikit-learn version is not supported
cross-version loading may occur but is unsupported and inadvisable
operations on cross-version-loaded state may produce unexpected results or errors
dependency-version metadata is relevant to reconstructing the training environment
InconsistentVersionWarning exists for estimators loaded under a version inconsistent with the one that pickled them
bounded_conclusion: The 1.7.2 producer environment has an authoritative version-sensitive persistence boundary when scikit-learn object state is consumed under another scikit-learn version.
claim_limits: does not prove a particular FreqAI artifact fails under 1.8.0
does not imply every cross-version artifact cannot deserialize
does not make InconsistentVersionWarning equivalent to a fatal failure
